reason: The batch report on the page and behind the QR code is exactly what I check before buying, and $24.99 for the first box is something I can try once. I would only do one box, not two.
objection: I would open the report first. If the lab name is vague or the batch number does not match, I am out. Also $29.99 every month is a lot on my budget.
would_change_my_mind: A lab report that is missing, not for my batch, or from a lab I cannot look up would flip me to no.
